title: Simulink and DLL SIL
current_gap: The owned model has local build evidence; the complete selection, initialization, run, reset and export flow is accepted separately, and daily runs are not required to start Simulink.

atoms.name: owned_model_build
atoms.required: Repeatable local build from the vendor ZIP to the owned .so with hashes on record

atoms.name: no_controller_run
atoms.required: Pure model run without a flight controller in bounded slices

atoms.name: selection_initialization
atoms.required: Complete model selection and initialization flow with identity and errors

atoms.name: reset_export
atoms.required: Reset and export flow with state identity and file evidence

atoms.name: original_dll_plugin
atoms.required: Original DLL as an optional plugin under a verified ABI; #9 remains open

atoms.name: simulink_not_required
atoms.required: Daily operation never requires Simulink; MATLAB stays a minimal interface

scope_rule: a local build is not the complete select/init/run/reset/export flow; an original DLL is an optional plugin, never a core prerequisite
